title: Structure-Preserving Generalized Manifold Galerkin Reduction for Port-Hamiltonian Systems
summary: This paper considers structure-preserving model order reduction (MOR) techniques for port-Hamiltonian (pH) systems, which are typically derived from energy-based modeling. To keep favorable properties of \pH systems such as passivity in a reduced order model (ROM), we use structure-preserving methods in the reduction process. Although projection-based structure-preserving MOR methods for nonlinear pH systems based on nonlinear approximation ansatzes have recently been proposed, existing approaches typically rely on specific structures of the approximation map and the underlying pH system.
